headline: A 'coming soon' Wallet has appeared in ChatGPT's settings, hinting at how OpenAI's agents might pay for things.
score_reason: Lowered from 5: an unconfirmed screenshot, no OpenAI comment, and the World Money link is the writer's speculation.
importance_line: ChatGPT users may get a built-in way to let an agent pay at any store, which matters as Amazon blocks rival agents, but OpenAI has said nothing and the suggested tie to Sam Altman's World Money is a theory, not a fact.
summary: TestingCatalog, a site that tracks unreleased app features, reports that a screenshot of ChatGPT's settings shows a Wallet option marked "Coming soon", and argues it would give OpenAI's always-on Dots agents a way to pay after the company pulled back its earlier Instant Checkout program. OpenAI has not commented, and the site itself says nothing public shows the wallet is connected to World Money, the stablecoin wallet from the Altman-co-founded Tools for Humanity announced on 17 Sep 2026, so the link remains speculation.
notes: Single-outlet report based on a screenshot; treated as preliminary.
